questions.question: Verify the historical name of the Genevan institution and the precise title of Cramer’s appointment.

localizations.source: Verify the historical name of the Genevan institution and the precise title of Cramer’s appointment.
localizations.ru: Уточнить историческое название женевского учебного заведения и точное наименование должности Крамера.

questions.resolution: The Academy of Geneva created a new mathematics chair in 1724 for Cramer and Jean-Louis Calandrini; Cramer held it alone from 1734. https://hls-dhs-dss.ch/de/articles/025878/2005-08-17/

questions.question: Clarify the history of the term determinant and the description of Cayley’s later work as following immediately.

localizations.source: Clarify the history of the term determinant and the description of Cayley’s later work as following immediately.
localizations.ru: Уточнить историю термина «определитель» и оценку «сразу же» для последующих работ Кэли.

questions.resolution: Clarified: Gauss introduced the word determinant in 1801 in a different sense; its modern use is associated with Cauchy’s 1812 paper. The chronologically misleading claim that Cayley followed immediately has been removed. https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/HistTopics/Matrices_and_determinants/

questions.question: Verify the dates of the collected works and Bernoulli correspondence; the French title spelling follows the visible 1750 title page.

localizations.source: Verify the dates of the collected works and Bernoulli correspondence; the French title spelling follows the visible 1750 title page.
localizations.ru: Подтвердить даты многотомных изданий и переписки Бернулли; написание французского заглавия приведено к видимому титулу 1750 года.

questions.resolution: Verified: Johann Bernoulli, Opera omnia, 4 volumes (1742); Jacob Bernoulli, Opera, 2 volumes (1744); Leibniz–Johann Bernoulli correspondence, 2 volumes (1745), co-edited with Castillon. https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/DSB/Cramer.pdf
